spec_match.rationale: Directly probes WebTransport.prototype.draining and its property descriptor getter, and models the exact HTTP/3 DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x78ae) handover lifecycle where in-flight streams finish on Session A while new streams route to Session B.

interactive.rationale: Provides live controls to re-run the IDL probe, configure stream work duration, open bidirectional streams, trigger DRAIN_WEBTRANSPORT_SESSION (0x78ae), and watch real-time stream drain completion.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card promise of a live WebTransport.prototype.draining IDL probe paired with an interactive Session A to Session B stream handover simulator.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles browsers where WebTransport.prototype.draining is absent without throwing, automatically seeds an in-flight stream if drain is triggered while idle, and transitions Session A to CLOSED (GRACEFUL) once active streams reach zero.

references.rationale: Includes https://chromestatus.com/feature/6427766428925952 and the W3C WebTransport #dom-webtransport-draining spec link.

conformance.rationale: Backed by v157/webtransport-draining/conformance.json testing WebTransport, WebTransport.prototype.draining, its prototype getter descriptor, and lifecycle Promise coexistence.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified IDL probe execution, stream creation, drain trigger handover, and responsive layout across desktop and 360px mobile viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Emits showcaseTelemetry.assert('webtransport-draining-idl-probe') with prototype and descriptor inspection state and zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Uses only shared CSS custom properties from /public/styles.css with explicit background and color pairs on every button rule and zero raw hex/rgba/hsla colors.

accessibility.rationale: All form controls have explicit labels and >=44px tap targets, live regions use aria-live=polite, and <pre> blocks have tabindex=0.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Uses auto-fit responsive session cards and an overflow-x:auto wrapper around the stream routing table so 360x740 mobile viewports have zero horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer rendering heavy content below the fold
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply content-visibility: auto and contain-intrinsic-size to below-the-fold sections to reduce initial rendering work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .deferred-section with content-visibility: auto and contain-intrinsic-size: auto 260px to the code path and reference sections.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible form controls and minimum touch target sizing
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Associate every form control with an explicit <label> and ensure interactive controls have at least 44px height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Associated the stream duration <select> with an explicit <label for='stream-duration-select'> and enforced min-height: 44px on all buttons and selects.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status announcements and keyboard focusable code blocks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live='polite' outputs for asynchronous state transitions and tabindex='0' on scrollable <pre> blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Added aria-live='polite' to #probe-output and #handover-log, and tabindex='0' on the <pre> block.

guidanceConsulted.query: prevent horizontal table overflow on narrow 360px viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wrap wide data tables in an overflow-x: auto container and use responsive grid tracks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Wrapped the live stream routing table in .table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; max-width: 100%; } and used minmax(240px, 1fr) session cards.

summary: Interactive WebTransport.prototype.draining IDL probe and zero-downtime Session A -> Session B bidirectional stream handover lab.
